name: Aggregate Balance Information 3
definition: Net position of a segregated holding, in a single security, within the overall position held in a securities account. A securities balance is calculated from the sum of securities' receipts minus the sum of securities' deliveries.

AggregateQuantity.name: Aggregate Quantity
AggregateQuantity.definition: Total quantity of financial instrument for the referenced holding.

DaysAccrued.name: Days Accrued
DaysAccrued.definition: Specifies the number of days used for calculating the accrued interest amount.

HoldingValue.name: Holding Value
HoldingValue.definition: Total value of a balance of the securities account for a specific financial instrument, expressed in one or more currencies.

PreviousHoldingValue.name: Previous Holding Value
PreviousHoldingValue.definition: Previous total value of a balance of the securities account for a specific financial instrument, expressed in one or more currencies.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest amount that has accrued in between coupon payment periods.

AccruedInterestAmountSign.name: Accrued Interest Amount Sign
AccruedInterestAmountSign.definition: Indicates whether the accrued interest is a positive or negative amount.

BookValue.name: Book Value
BookValue.definition: Value of a security, as booked in an account. Book value is often different from the current market value of the security.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Security held on the account for which the balance is calculated.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Price of the financial instrument in one or more currencies.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Currency exchange related to a securities order.

BalanceBreakdownDetails.name: Balance Breakdown Details
BalanceBreakdownDetails.definition: Net position of a segregated holding of a single security within the overall position held in a securities account, eg, sub-balance per status.

AdditionalBalanceBreakdownDetails.name: Additional Balance Breakdown Details
AdditionalBalanceBreakdownDetails.definition: Net position of a segregated holding of a single security within the overall position held in a securities account, eg, sub-balance per status.

BalanceAtSafekeepingPlace.name: Balance At Safekeeping Place
BalanceAtSafekeepingPlace.definition: Net position of a segregated holding, in a single security, within the overall position held in a securities account at a specified place of safekeeping.

BalanceAtSafekeepingPlaceRule.definition: If SafekeepingPlace is present, then BalanceAtSafekeepingPlace is not allowed.

AccruedInterestAmountSignRule.definition: If AccruedInterestAmount is present, then AccruedInterestAmountSign must be present. If AccruedInterestAmount is not present, then AccruedInterestAmountSign may not be present.
